newsitem.title: UK: Wetter weather possible in May, UK forecasters say.
newsitem.headline: Wetter weather possible in May, UK forecasters say.

text.p: Britain's drought could come to an end in May, according to the latest long term weather forecast.
But the rest of April is set to stay dry, the Meteorological Office said.
The dry weather has helped push up grains prices amid market nervousness about the effect on the developing crop.
"The general forecast for the first half of May points to the possibility of some wetter weather," a Meteorological Office spokesman said.
Shorter term forecasts show no rain in the coming week, except for some possible showers in the far north east.
